scope: Two non-production animated story page studies and proposed brand copy. Existing identity is retained; no website source edits.
brief_evidence: User supplied five origin/ambition milestones and requested interesting storytelling, two initial directions, animation and fidelity to the brand identity.

directions.name: A seed of something bigger
directions.composition: An open, alternating chapter journey connected by a growing vertical line. A five-stage illustrated hero establishes the arc.
directions.motion: Chapter reveals, line progress and crop illustration draw-on explain chronological growth; no photo zoom.
directions.benefit: Makes the origin and expanding ambition immediately understandable and memorable.
directions.tradeoff: Longer page; pacing needs generous but purposeful gaps.

directions.name: The grower's journal
directions.composition: A centered editorial opening followed by a sticky illustrated chapter index and spacious reading column.
directions.motion: The chapter marker and illustration change as the reader reaches each chapter; short text reveals preserve reading rhythm.
directions.benefit: A more intimate, reflective experience with clear orientation through the story.
directions.tradeoff: Less spectacle; the desktop sticky composition becomes a simple stacked narrative on mobile.

motion.reduced_motion: All copy and illustrations visible; no reveal, progress interpolation or decorative translation.
motion.scroll: Native browser scrolling; never lock, hijack, or autoplay chapters.

imagery.study: Existing Field Notes crop icons composed as symbolic illustrations, plus supplied logo. These are not documentary evidence.
imagery.future: Use actual founder terrace/indoor-growing photographs if available. Existing produce imagery can support crop chapters; do not label unrelated farm or generated scenes as historical photographs.

claim_boundary: Fresh and organic supply and market leadership remain ambitions. No invented dates, founders, certifications, customers, operational achievements or origin photographs.

purpose.prominence: One heading and paragraph at a time
purpose.removal_cost: Journey becomes a generic mission statement

purpose.need: Understand the ambition and continue to the produce

phases.0: Current nested checkout verified; output restricted to a new proposal directory
phases.1: Brief supplied explicitly in the request
phases.3: No external research needed for founder-supplied copy and bounded local studies
phases.4: Two territories requested, rather than skill default three
phases.5: Existing palette/type/icons retained; no new identity selection
phases.7: Both requested compositions use the existing approved palette
phases.8: Interactive comparison, copy and scoped proposal sources

pending: User selection, combination or revision of direction and copy before website implementation
